digest.component_or_area: Documentation and architecture decisions (S3 ticket-store backend)
propositions: Documentation must cover the optional git-remote-s3 dependency and its installation via pip install 'nava-rebar[s3]' with minimum version 0.3.2
sync.remote configuration must be documented to accept s3://bucket/prefix URIs and link to the new S3 backend operator guide

A new docs/s3-backend.md guide must explain SSE-KMS bucket setup, IAM policy scoping, credentials trust boundary via boto3 chain, and auto-doctor self-heal behavior for stale locks (60s TTL via GIT_REMOTE_S3_LOCK_TTL_SECONDS)
ADR 0093 must record the architectural decision to use git-remote-s3, SSE-KMS encryption, merge-based auto-doctor, and rejection of lock TTL lowering
The ADR index generation scripts (gen_adr_index.py and check_adr_numbers.py) must validate the ADR number-to-file bijection and regenerate docs/adr/README.md without dangling cross-references
